# Orange Books Knowledge Base

> An independent community library of AI engineering resources whose first collection is HuaShu's AI Orange Books.

The text of a book is in this library only when the book has a "Mirrored book" section below, and each of those books carries its author's own license. Every other book is cataloged with a link to the author's official source. Resolve an id to its record and citation with `python3 scripts/resolve.py <id>`, and check the citations of a document with `python3 scripts/check_citations.py <file>`.

## Agent instructions

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): How to search this library, read a chapter, quote it, and cite it.

## Mirrored book: Loop Engineering: Stop Asking Me What It Is

- [Book record](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/metadata.yaml): `loop-engineering-orange-book`, by HuaShu. English edition v260615, which is behind the newest Chinese edition v261020. License MIT.
- [License](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/LICENSE): The author's license text and copyright notice, which cover this book.
- [§01 Stop Asking: What Loop Engineering Really Is](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/01-what-loop-engineering-really-is.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/what-loop-engineering-really-is`, source PDF pp. 3-5.
- [§02 From Prompt to Context to Loop](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/02-from-prompt-to-context-to-loop.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/from-prompt-to-context-to-loop`, source PDF pp. 6-8.
- [§03 The Five Moves of One Loop](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/03-five-moves-of-one-loop.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/five-moves-of-one-loop`, source PDF pp. 9-12.
- [§04 Six Parts: What a Loop Is Built From](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/04-six-parts-of-a-loop.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/six-parts-of-a-loop`, source PDF pp. 13-16.
- [§05 Generator and Evaluator: Why an AI Can't Grade Its Own Code](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/05-generator-and-evaluator.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/generator-and-evaluator`, source PDF pp. 17-20.
- [§06 Loops That Run While You Sleep: Three Real Ones](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/06-loops-that-run-while-you-sleep.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/loops-that-run-while-you-sleep`, source PDF pp. 21-24.
- [§07 The Costs: Verification Debt, Comprehension Rot, Token Blowout](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/07-costs.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/costs`, source PDF pp. 25-28.
- [§08 Stay the Engineer, Not Just the One Who Presses Go](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/08-stay-the-engineer.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/stay-the-engineer`, source PDF pp. 29-31.
- [§09 Build Your First Loop Today](books/loop-engineering-orange-book/chapters/09-build-your-first-loop.md): `loop-engineering-orange-book/build-your-first-loop`, source PDF pp. 32-35.

## Books that are not mirrored

These books are cataloged with their license evidence. Read them at the author's official source, and do not quote them from this library.

## Indexes

- [index/catalog.json](index/catalog.json): Every book with its license id, mirror status, quote-permitted flag, editions, and official URLs.
- [index/chapters.jsonl](index/chapters.jsonl): One JSON object per line for each mirrored chapter, with its id, path, source pages, and errata.
- [index/topics.json](index/topics.json): Every topic with the books and chapters it references.
